name: Corrupted Crossroads
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}. ({C} represents colorless mana.)
{T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a spell with devoid.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a spell with devoid.

needs.what: devoid as a real, queryable characteristic of a card/spell (not just 'has no colors'), plus a mana_restriction cast-group predicate such as {"keyword": "devoid"} so mana can be limited to casting spells with devoid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_restriction groups accept only lowercased type/subtype names, {"chosen_type_of": "self"}, and the predicates mana_value and x_in_mana_cost; there is no keyword predicate, and devoid is not in the keyword list at all (the templates treat it as self-implementing by leaving colors empty). A restriction to colorless spells is not equivalent: it would also fund colorless artifacts and Eldrazi without devoid, a strictly better card
